title: Phase 5 / E03: Minimal Token / Capability Comparator Baseline Protocol
primary_question: Can a minimal capability token (MIN_READSET_TOKEN) or HMAC-signed readset token achieve decision equivalence with GLHS exact-disclosure context bindings while reducing metadata serialized byte overhead and database query count?
unit_of_analysis: One clinical proposal schedule executed across 4 baseline and comparator arms.

primary_endpoints.name: Admission Decision Disagreement Rate
primary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of schedules where comparator decision differs from GLHS GRWC decision.

secondary_endpoints.name: Serialized Token Byte Overhead
secondary_endpoints.definition: Mean token size in bytes across comparator arms.

sample_size.unit_definition: 352 unique schedules replayed across 4 comparator mechanisms

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: If comparator achieves equal safety with lower overhead, equivalence must be published.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Missing schedules are excluded from comparative overhead calculations.
